messages:
ben_h: Heads up — vendor_sky just flagged a partial DOA for the shipment that landed yesterday (40x A100). Need a quick plan: consolidation, lead times for replacements, and cost delta. AWBs on file: AWB12345, AWB12346. One pallet stuck in FRA customs. @lucy_p can you check insurance coverage? @vendor_sky what's ETA on replacements and any immediate ship options?

vendor_sky: Hey all — confirmed 6 DOA so far (investigating root cause). Replacement ETA is 14 business days after RMA approval from factory. We can consolidate into a single AWB but that adds handling and requires customs re-declaration (HS code: 8471). Freight delta for consolidation is +$2,100. Expedited option (air) possible: 5 business days for +$4,800.

lucy_p: Insurance status: current policy covers CIF value on both AWBs, not expedited surcharge. If you consolidate and raise declared value we need an addendum to the insurance binder. I can submit — finance sign-off required for extra premium.

neil_ops: 6 DOA is going to bite our backlog. Is there any local EU RMA pool or borrow we can tap to get immediate capacity? Waiting 14bd will hurt SLOs.

vendor_sky: EU pool limited. We can allocate 2 units from NL staging for next-day dispatch if you accept partial replacements. Remaining 4 would ship from factory in ~10 business days (we can compress to 8bd if you take air for the remainder).

priya_s: From a cost perspective: holding/backlog cost is non-trivial. Quick calc: 40 GPUs idling at $0.40/hr = ~$384/day in opportunity cost for high-util workloads. We should weigh expedite cost vs lost revenue. Also need serial numbers for the 6 defective units to produce RMA labels.

ben_h: OK — we approve allocating 2 immediate replacements by next-day air, but only for those two. For the remaining 4 take the standard 10bd factory ship (no expedite) and issue prorated credit for downtime. Consolidation is fine if it lowers customs risk, but only if insurance addendum is confirmed. Sending serials now:

ben_h: ```
S/N: GPU-A-00123
S/N: GPU-A-00124
S/N: GPU-A-00125
S/N: GPU-A-00126
S/N: GPU-A-00127
S/N: GPU-A-00128
```

logistics_bot: AWB consolidation request created: #AWB-789. Status: awaiting vendor confirmation and signed customs waiver.

vendor_sky: We can consolidate and issue a new AWB. Need a signed customs reclassification waiver (we'll attach language). Also need PO amendment to cover the +$2,100 handling if you want consolidation, and +$4,800 only if you opt to expedite the remaining 4. If you sign waiver by EOD we can push manifest and labels today.

lucy_p: I can sign the insurance addendum once finance approves premium. Finance — heads up that expedited/handling will require PO change. @ben_h please confirm budget approval for the 2x next-day air.

ben_h: Approve next-day air for the 2 immediate units (charge to ops contingency). Do not expedite the remaining 4. Approve consolidation to single AWB subject to insurance addendum being executed. @vendor_sky send final invoice and new AWB when ready; include RMA manifest with the S/Ns above.

vendor_sky: Roger. I'll prepare new AWB and invoice this afternoon, and email formal waiver for signature. Labels and RMA manifest will include the serials you provided. Tracking posted once AWB generated.

priya_s: Please include a prorated downtime credit line item on the invoice for the 4 delayed units as discussed so Finance can net it against the replacement charge.

vendor_sky: Will include a credit line for the 4 units (T&C: subject to confirmed DOA after depot inspection).

ben_h: Great. Thanks everyone. Please ping here with AWB and invoice links. :thumbsup:

logistics_bot: Note — customs contact in FRA: D. Meier (+49 30 1234). If customs requests paperwork, route to lucy_p and vendor_sky.
